::: {#def-simulation-estimate}
#### Simulation estimate

A **simulation estimate** of the expectation $\E{T}$ of an estimate $T$
is the average of the [replications](#def-replication)' estimates $T_1, \ldots, T_M$:

$$\bar T_M \eqdef \frac{1}{M} \sumto{m}{M} T_m.$$

The [bias](estimation.qmd#def-bias) of $\hparam$ for an [estimand](estimation.qmd#def-estimand) $\param$
is estimated by $\bar T_M - \param$,
and the [mean squared error](estimation.qmd#def-mse) by the average of $(T_m - \param)^2$.
:::
